other_conditions: Applicant must be a public limited company, private limited company, partnership firm, limited liability partnership, one‑person company, or sole proprietorship registered under Indian law
Applicant must be an MSME or a startup
Startup must be recognized by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) as per Government of India guidelines
If incorporated for less than 3 years from the date of application, the startup is considered a nascent startup
Nascent startup must be incubated at a Central or State government‑assisted incubator
Startup must not have received any grants or grants‑in‑aid from any government scheme for a similar technology
Startup must be owned and controlled by a Resident Indian citizen with at least 51% shareholding
benefits_summary: Provides up to 90% funding (maximum INR 5,000,000,000) for project costs, with additional support of up to 20% for incubators and up to 40% contribution from academia.
